style: Use the attached images ONLY as a STYLE reference for the LINE and the flat playful editorial look — match their bold confident black ink outlines, flat colors with NO gradients and minimal shading. Do NOT copy their colors. Use instead a flat limited PASTEL palette: mint green #B6E5CF, powder blue #AFC9E8, pale butter yellow #F6E7A8, soft blush pink #F6C6DA, and black, on a PLAIN WHITE background. Draw a brand-new illustration in that style.
end: Draw NO people and no faces. Generous empty white space around the subject. Absolutely no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no captions.

cards.prompt: A strip of small blank tiles on the left, an arrow, and on the right three finished objects the tiles became: a feather, a single strand of hair, and a small rounded blob. Flat and simple.

A two-step diagram: a walled sphere with a coiled thread inside and a ribbon copy leaving it, an arrow across, then a small two-lobed machine running along that ribbon with a string of beads growing behind it. Flat and simple.
A long ribbon of small blank tiles, bracketed underneath into groups of exactly three, with a line from each group of three up to one bead in a growing chain. Flat and simple.
A wooden rack of twenty small test tubes at night, nineteen of them plain and one filled and glowing pale, with a round wall clock behind showing three o'clock. Flat and simple.
A horizontal strip of blank tiles with a small pennant flag planted on the tile at the left end and a solid square block capping the tile at the right end. Flat and simple.

A round table-wheel of small blank segments at the centre, with four living things arranged around it and a line from each to the wheel: a rod-shaped bacterium, a round yeast bud, an oak leaf, and a whale. Flat and simple.
A round-bottomed flask of cloudy liquid with a tiny closed loop of thread entering it by an arrow, and a small labelled-free glass vial of clear liquid leaving it by another arrow. Flat and simple.
Four round flat blood cells in a row and one crescent-shaped sickled cell at the end, with a short strip of tiles above where a single tile is drawn in a different colour. Flat and simple.
A plate of food on a table with a string of beads lifting out of it and coming apart into single loose beads, which reassemble into a new shorter string at the side. Flat and simple.
